question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "interacting."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The reason for using **"interacting"** in the blank is to convey the idea of engaging in direct, face-to-face communication with friends and family. (प्रत्यक्ष, आमने-सामने संचार में संलग्न होने का विचार)

 
 
• **Example**: *She enjoys interacting__ with her colleagues during team meetings.*
 
 
 
• **"Interacting"** suggests a more dynamic and personal form of engagement compared to passive activities.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

Correct paragraph:

Social media can have __detrimental__ effects on mental health, with studies suggesting that excessive use can lead to feelings of anxiety, depression, and loneliness. To combat these negative effects, experts recommend setting __rules__ for social media use. Other strategies include __**interacting**__ with friends and family in person, engaging in hobbies or physical activity, and seeking professional ______ (4) ______ if necessary. As such, it's important to be ______ (5) ______ of its potential drawbacks and take steps to use it in a healthy and balanced way.

• Cooperating: **to work with somebody else to achieve something. ((किसी से) सहयोग करना; मिलकर काम करना)
 
• **Involving: **to make something necessary. (किसी बात को आवश्‍यक बनाना, के लिए आवश्‍यक होना, की अपेक्षा करना)
 
• **Entrusting: **to make somebody responsible for something. ((किसी को किसी काम का) दायित्‍व सौंपना)
